candidates.title: Directed soft cell reassignment with fixed codeword separation
candidates.falsifier: On the admitted cold run, measure the frozen held-out pair-level ER, level-0 code count and Gini, L1-to-L2 branches per L1 code, train-to-test frequency drift, sequence information, and Stage-3 recall@10/NDCG@10. The mechanism is falsified if Stage-3 quality does not exceed the archived control or if ER rises only alongside a violation of the required structure.
candidates.risk: The soft assignment pressure may be too weak to change hard assignments, or may change them by unevenly redistributing item mass despite the separation barrier. The barrier preserves geometric distance, not occupancy, prefix branching, train-to-test frequency drift, sequence information, or Stage-3 ranking quality.
candidates.codebook_interaction: The source-conditioned assignment term moves codewords to change which existing cells receive pair endpoints; the barrier penalizes distinct participating codewords whose distance falls below the specified floor. It therefore promotes reassignment among separated cells rather than pulling a pair's two codewords together. It does not guarantee cell sizes or hard-SID changes.

candidates.title: Directed capacity-regularized soft assignment repartition
candidates.falsifier: Compare the one cold run with the archived control on held-out pair-level ER, hard level-0 code count and Gini, prefix branches, frequency drift, sequence information, and Stage-3 recall@10/NDCG@10. Failure to improve Stage-3 recall, or any structural degradation accompanying an ER increase, falsifies the intended benefit.
candidates.risk: The batch usage regularizer may enforce uniformity that conflicts with the true catalogue distribution, while batch-local soft usage may not preserve global hard-assignment capacities. The directed KL can also improve conditional assignment consistency without improving the frozen held-out ER or recommendation ranking.
candidates.codebook_interaction: The directed KL term changes codeword positions through the soft assignment distributions so target assignments are conditioned on source assignments. The aggregate KL term discourages a batch-level collapse of soft usage toward a few codewords. The pair-conditioned barrier penalizes bringing distinct source/target-associated codewords inside delta, preventing pair-codeword convergence rather than rewarding it.

candidates.title: Source-conditioned residual geometry transport with codeword repulsion
candidates.falsifier: Use the cold run's single frozen evaluation to test whether held-out pair-level ER and Stage-3 recall@10/NDCG@10 both improve over control while code count, Gini, prefix branches, frequency drift, and sequence information satisfy the stated requirements. Any downstream regression or structural violation despite an ER gain falsifies the mechanism's premise.
candidates.risk: A residual direction may not correspond to a useful cell boundary change: transport can move codewords toward dense regions, alter cell sizes, or fail to change hard assignments. The repulsion term may counteract the transport signal, and neither term directly guarantees preservation of prefix structure or Stage-3 ranking.
candidates.codebook_interaction: Each source-conditioned codeword is pulled toward a point partway along the source-to-target residual, changing the source-side partition according to directed behavior geometry. The barrier repels that source-associated codeword from the target's nearest codeword when their distance is below delta. Thus the transport signal is directional while the explicit codebook force opposes pair-codeword convergence.
